claims: A $700 million settlement was reached in the Google Play Store Antitrust lawsuit.
The Google Play Store Antitrust lawsuit claims that Google monopolized app distribution and in-app billing, causing higher prices for consumers.
The Android Data Collection lawsuit alleges that Android devices sent data to Google over cellular networks even when idle.
The Android Data Collection lawsuit resulted in a $135 million settlement.
The deadline to file a claim in the Android Data Collection lawsuit is May 9, 2026.
Google agreed to pay $68 million to settle claims that it illegally recorded private conversations via its voice assistant.
The Incognito Mode Privacy lawsuit was tentatively settled.
The Incognito Mode Privacy lawsuit alleges tracking in Chrome's Incognito mode.
The Incognito Mode Privacy lawsuit is pending.
A potential $100 million settlement exists regarding overpayments in the AdWords program in the Advertiser Monopoly lawsuit.
